title: Florvis: AI-powered data extraction and real-time dashboards for rose farms
summary: Rose farms were running production, costs and profits on paper and spreadsheets. I built Florvis, a full stack SaaS with a Gemini-powered pipeline that turns invoices, reports and photos into structured data — now used by 25+ farms.
metaTitle: Florvis Case Study: Production AI Deployment with Gemini — Bertil Tandayamo
metaDescription: How a Forward Deployed Engineer shipped Florvis: a full stack SaaS for rose farms with Gemini API document and image extraction that removes manual data entry. Used by 25+ clients.
problem: Rose farm owners had no reliable, real-time view of production, costs and profitability. Data lived in paper invoices, PDF reports and spreadsheets spread across the farm.
Getting that data into any system meant someone typing it in by hand — slow, error-prone and the main reason farms gave up on digital tools.
solution: Worked directly with farm owners to map how data actually flows on a farm, then designed Florvis as a multi-tenant web app with Next.js, React, Node.js and TypeScript on PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Integrated the Gemini API to read invoices, reports, files and images and convert them into structured text and records, so users upload a document instead of typing it.
Built real-time dashboards for production, profits and costs with clear visuals designed for non-technical users.

results.label: data entry from invoices, reports and images via the Gemini API
visibility into production, profits and costs

stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Gemini API

title: Crowdmuse: scaling a phygital creator marketplace and cutting infrastructure waste
summary: A phygital marketplace for creators was wasting provider requests and paying high gas fees. I optimized the integration layer and refactored the smart contracts — cutting unused provider requests by 84.64%.
metaTitle: Crowdmuse Case Study: API Integration & Scalability — Bertil Tandayamo
metaDescription: How a Forward Deployed Engineer reduced unused third-party provider requests by 84.64% and cut smart-contract gas fees for Crowdmuse, a phygital creator marketplace.
problem: Crowdmuse lets creators sell physical products backed by blockchain technology. As usage grew, the app was sending large volumes of unnecessary requests to third-party providers, driving up cost and limiting scalability.
On-chain operations were also expensive: gas fees made transactions costly for the business and its creators.
solution: Audited how the Next.js and Firebase application talked to external providers and removed redundant and unused calls, restructuring data fetching around what each screen actually needed.
Refactored the smart contracts to reduce the cost of on-chain operations without changing the product experience.
stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Solidity
